act_title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

dialogue.t: Dear Odette, come and build a snowman with me ♪~
Or hop on a train, roaming Snezhnaya with glee ♪~
It's been ages since you've come to play~ I've been singing to the fish all day~
Though the stage is far from empty~ You know I'm feeling so alone~ Just watching as the time ticks by ♪~
"No! I do not wish to drag you into the water. I am not some water imp!"
...You've rehearsed enough. You know your lines by heart.
No, no. You're supposed to tell me not to be nervous. That I'm gonna do great!
